title: Add version to knowledge-track plugin.json
body: `claude plugin validate .` warns: `plugins[0] plugin.json -> version: No version specified`. The commits call it v0.2; set `"version": "0.2.0"`. The marketplace metadata says 0.1.0, so update that too.
close_reason: version 0.2.0, f34c341 on dev; plugin validate passes with no warnings
